name: orchestrator-server
description: Orchestrator Server - API server with MongoDB/NeDB persistence

scripts.pkg:win: npm run pkg:prepare && pkg dist/server.js --config package.json --targets node24-win-x64 --output ../../release/orchestrator-server-win.exe && node scripts/patch-exe.mjs
scripts.pkg:linux: npm run pkg:prepare && pkg dist/server.js --config package.json --targets node24-linux-x64 --output ../../release/orchestrator-server-linux
scripts.pkg:all: npm run pkg:prepare && pkg dist/server.js --config package.json --targets node24-win-x64 --output ../../release/orchestrator-server-win.exe && pkg dist/server.js --config package.json --targets node24-linux-x64 --output ../../release/orchestrator-server-linux && node scripts/patch-exe.mjs
